items.author: DailyDarkWeb
items.context: Daily Dark Web (@DailyDarkWeb): Trezor confirma que su laboratorio encontró implantes de hardware no autorizados en tres Trezor Safe 5 vendidas por CryptoBilis, un revendedor del sudeste asiático, tras su advertencia de octubre.
items.suggested_text: This is the part of hardware wallets most people skip: you're trusting the reseller, the supply chain and the firmware, not just the device. Buy direct and verify, or take the vendor out of the equation. I wrote a book on building your own air-gapped setup: https://www.amazon.com/dp/B0HQ5NS31N?dplnkId=c09ef739-11f3-4c76-8c62-92ce160a3341&nodl=1

items.author: DrProfitCrypto
items.context: Doctor Profit (@DrProfitCrypto), reporte dominical: sigue bullish; reconoce que su long desde $80K no funcionó. Cita Fear & Greed en 10, RSI diario ~19, un costo de producción estimado ~$61.200 y un clúster de liquidaciones en $62K; cree que la venta del sábado buscó esas liquidaciones y quiere ampliar spot en $60K–$64K.
items.suggested_text: Separating long-term spot buying from trading is the most useful part here. The production-cost floor is interesting, but it rests on a few past cycles and estimates vary by source. Spot without leverage is what lets you survive being early. $BTC

items.author: mrofwallstreet
items.context: Mr. Wall Street (@mrofwallstreet), comentario semanal: sexta semana bajista, de $75.000 a $62.000 (~17%), por debajo de la MA200 semanal (~$68K). Duda de las explicaciones (Binance, IPO de Anthropic) y lo atribuye a caza de liquidez. Promedio spot $68K, objetivo $97.000+ para el 1T 2027; su sesgo se invalida si el mercado acepta precios bajo $64K.
items.suggested_text: The invalidation level is more useful than the target. Acceptance below $64K is something anyone can check; $97K by Q1 2027 isn't. For spot holders, having a plan for both cases matters more than guessing who sold on a weekend. $BTC

items.author: sabrinacallz
items.context: Sabrina (@sabrinacallz): dice que Bitcoin va a $30.000; recuerda que en el último bear market cayó de $69.000 a $15.476 (−77%) y que suele caer al menos 70–80% en cada bear market: "This time will be no different."
items.suggested_text: 70-80% drawdowns did happen in past cycles, but that's three or four data points. "This time will be no different" is as much a bet as "this time is different." Without leverage, you don't need to know which one is right. $BTC

items.author: KillaXBT
items.context: Killa (@KillaXBT): "The bear market floor is approaching"; dice que nunca ha sido mal momento comprar $BTC en este periodo del ciclo, con gráfico adjunto.
items.suggested_text: Historically true for spot buyers with a long horizon. The catch is that "around this period" only looks obvious in hindsight. Sizing so you can keep buying if it goes lower is what makes it work. $BTC
